protocol.incumbentFrom: oc-protocol/2 (claw2.json): bc kept every gym scenario, 0 promotions
protocol.lm: ra-lm, ra-lm-h (ra-lm-h/1, arena-declared-r7.json + amendment 1) and ra-lm-h48 (H 48, arena-declared-r8.json) built as arena_eval builds them: lmOptions { texts: raLmTaskTexts(raReadStation), stationFor: the three headless station rooms }
protocol.interval: Wilson 95% interval on the success rate over the declared seeds
protocol.promotion: challenger lower bound > incumbent upper bound, ruleBreaks = 0, governorChecked = stepsRun, physical = 0; the scripted expert is never a candidate

arena.governor: VBRIDGE vbGovernor.monitor on every step of a seeded safe simulated job (half the rig's speed limit, nearest person 8 m); a broken safe-practice rule is a deviation and halts the run with a protective stop
arena.note: ra-lm (ra/1), ra-lm-h (ra-lm-h/1) and ra-lm-h48 (ra-lm-h48/1) are small language-conditioned models trained here (not large language models), built with their declared texts and station tasks; reactive is a hand-written rule policy
